goal: Accurately warn users about required disk space on first run
Prevent pruned nodes from incorrectly warning that hundreds of gigabytes are required
Fix unit inconsistencies between internal checks and displayed warnings
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified calculation discrepancy between silent check and display (mercie-ux)
Tested that pruned nodes now warn for target size rather than the full chain (jeanpablojp)
Supported keeping internal units in GiB while updating user strings (achow101, murchandamus)
Concluded GiB granularity for pruned nodes is acceptable for now (hebasto)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it corrects misleading startup disk warnings for pruned nodes needing small storage
The benefit is minor user-facing clarity on initial launch without affecting core node operation
